run_experiment_all_algos: run a BenchMARL experiment with all registered algorithms on the MAgent adversarial pursuit task
run_experiment_gnn: run a BenchMARL experiment with Ippo, Qmix, or ISAC algorithms using a CNN-GNN model on MAgent
run_experiment_lstm: run a BenchMARL experiment with Ippo, Qmix, or MASAC algorithms using a CNN-LSTM model on MAgent
test_reloading_trainer: test reloading a BenchMARL experiment trainer from saved checkpoints using IppoConfig on MAgent
test_share_policy_params: test running BenchMARL experiments with shared or independent policy parameters using Qmix or MASAC on MAgent
